summary: Paysafe Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, announcing a refinancing transaction to amend and extend its existing $814 million First Lien Term Loan (USD) and €586 million First Lien Term Loan (EUR), both due 2028, to 2030, alongside refinancing its $305 million Revolving Credit Facility due 2027 into a new upsized five-year facility. The filing also includes preliminary Q2 2026 select financial results, with estimated revenue of $447 million, net loss between $53-65 million, and adjusted EBITDA of $103 million. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This is a routine debt restructuring and preliminary earnings release, not a special situation event.
